result.title: Multi-Objective Causal Bandits: Minimal Intervention Space and Policy-Level Learning
result.comment: To appear in Proceedings of NeurIPS 26
result.summary: Many decision-making problems involve multiple objectives, where actions affect several performance metrics, fairness criteria, or safety constraints. We study multi-objective causal bandits with multiple reward nodes, where actions correspond to interventions on subsets of variables in a causal graph and performance is evaluated through Pareto optimality. Existing approaches to multi-objective bandits often rely on pairwise Pareto dominance or optimize a fixed scalarization. However, pairwise comparisons alone can fail to identify actions dominated by randomized policies, whose expected reward vectors lie in the convex hull of action-level rewards. Thus, an intervention may be suboptimal even if no single intervention dominates it, because it can be dominated by a randomized policy over other interventions. We formalize this policy-level phenomenon and show that it has consequences for both causal action-space reduction and online learning. First, we provide a necessary-and-sufficient graphical characterization of possibly Pareto- optimal minimal intervention sets. Our characterization yields a minimal, sound, and complete candidate intervention family from the graph alone, correcting prior formulations that may include intervention sets that are never Pareto-optimal under any compatible structural causal model. Second, over this reduced intervention space, we design an online UCB-style algorithm that eliminates actions using dominance tests against convex combinations of other actions, and prove logarithmic gap-dependent Pareto regret. Finally, we study constrained multi-objective causal bandits, where feasibility and optimality may be realized only with randomized policies, and develop an online UCB-style constrained bandit algorithm with sublinear regret and constraint-violation guarantees.

AI.brief_summary: 研究多目标因果 bandit：指出仅靠两两 Pareto 支配会遗漏被随机策略支配的干预，给出可能 Pareto 最优的最小干预集的图论刻画，并在缩小后的干预空间上设计 UCB 型算法，另扩展到带约束情形。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「最小干预集」刻画与「对被混合策略支配」的判据，可能为 LVR 中哪些视觉变量值得主动探查、以及证据获取与停止的分配提供形式化线索，需核查是否可迁用到推理期的干预式证据选择。
